summary_zh: 该项目是由社区维护的免费公共 API 汇总清单，按领域收录了大量可用的 API，适合在自有产品中查找和调用；README 还列出了 APILayer 系列 API 和 MCP 服务器条目，并说明可安装到 Claude、Cursor、VS Code 等客户端供 AI 代理调用。
audience_zh: 适合需要为产品寻找可用 API 的开发者、在多个领域查找接口的社区成员，以及想为 AI 代理配置 MCP 工具的用户。

evidence.quote: A collective list of free APIs

The Public APIs repository is manually curated by community members like you and folks working at [APILayer](https://apilayer.com/?utm_source=Github&utm_medium=Referral&utm_campaign=Public-apis-repo). It includes an extensive list of public APIs from many domains that you can use for your own produc

[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io) servers let AI agents call APIs as tools. You install one into a client, Claude, Cursor, VS Code, instead of calling it from your own code, so these entries list **transport** and **where you can install them** rather than `HTTPS`/`CORS`.
